### ANDRITZ to supply pump turbine for pumped storage modernization project in France

Électricité de France (EDF) has awarded international technology group ANDRITZ a contract to supply
a new pump turbine and associated equipment for the Vouglans/Saut-Mortier pumped storage project in
the French Jura region.

[ Read more ][57]
Jul 17, 2026

### Hyogo Pulp Industries places repeat order with ANDRITZ for pulp washing and refining

Hyogo Pulp Industries, Ltd. has awarded international technology group ANDRITZ an order to supply a
second DD-Washer drum displacer washer and a blowline refiner to its Tanigawa mill in Japan.

[ Read more ][58]
Jul 15, 2026

### Lenzing, Austria, selects ANDRITZ to supply new debarking and chipping line

Lenzing AG has awarded international technology group ANDRITZ an order to deliver a complete
debarking and chipping line for its pulp mill in Austria. 

[ Read more ][59]
Jul 14, 2026

### DS Smith starts up ANDRITZ stock preparation line with Europe’s largest FibreFlow drum pulper

DS Smith has successfully started up an ANDRITZ stock preparation line and reject treatment system
at its mill in Porcari, Italy, including Europe’s largest FibreFlow drum pulper. 

[ Read more ][60]
Jul 10, 2026

### Minhan Paper places repeat order with ANDRITZ for a new OCC line in Vietnam

Minhan Paper Joint Stock Company has placed an order with ANDRITZ to supply a complete old
corrugated containers (OCC) recycling line for its mill in Hung Yen province, Vietnam.

[ Read more ][61]

### ANDRITZ to modernize McCormick hydropower plant in Québec, Canada

Société en Commandite Hydroélectrique Manicouagan (SCHM) has awarded ANDRITZ a contract to modernize
turbine-generator units 6 and 7 at the McCormick hydropower plant in Baie-Comeau, Québec, Canada.

[ Read more ][62]

### Sustainable development: preserving our essentials

At SUEZ, our sustainable development roadmap is our blueprint to address the environmental and
climate challenges, go over and beyond our activities’ direct contribution to the ecological
transition, and thus accelerate our action to preserve what is essential. This is the profound
meaning of what we do at SUEZ, in the water and waste management businesses in which we have been
working with passion and determination for over 160 years.

### SUEZ innovation that matters

For more than 160 years, we have been innovating in the service of progress. We innovate when it
comes to the essentials: water, raw materials, energy, the climate. We share this mobilisation with
our customers and partners. Building on our historical expertise, as well as the new talent that
joins us, we are determined to accelerate innovation to preserve essential water and waste services,
both today and tomorrow.

# Wind technology powering tomorrow's energy systems

Siemens Gamesa is a global leader in wind energy, supporting companies and countries worldwide in
building resilient, affordable, and sustainable energy systems that accelerate the energy
transition.

[ [icon] Explore products and services ][28]
[Omterra logo following the announcement of the rebrand from Siemens Gamesa and Siemens Energy.]
Siemens Gamesa and Siemens Energy will become Omterra
Same team, same commitment – a new brand. Driven by our purpose to energize society, our strategy,
and our values.
[ Read our official announcement ][29]
1. Onshore
2. Offshore
3. Service

Your trusted technology partner

#### Onshore

Operating in 81 countries, Siemens Gamesa offers an extensive range of onshore wind turbine
technologies to cover all wind classes and site conditions. By listening to our customers - and
backed up by over 40 years of experience - we know just what it takes to develop and manage a
successful onshore project.

[
[icon]
Read more ][30]

Powerful performance

#### Offshore

Leading the way forward, our engineers and technicians pioneered the offshore sector back in 1991,
with the world’s first wind power plant in Denmark. Since then, Siemens Gamesa has grown to become
the global leader in offshore power generation. Offering full-scope solutions and services, our
people and products will guarantee the success of your next offshore project.

[
[icon]
Read more ][31]

World-class maintenance

#### Service

Siemens Gamesa has a proven track record of excellence in operation and maintenance. Leveraging
scale and global reach, we offer a flexible service portfolio that can be tailored to our customers’
diverse operating models. We also provide advanced diagnostics and digitalization capabilities, as
well as customized offshore offerings.

[
[icon]
Read more ][32]

**Career**

#### Passionate about renewables

It takes the brightest minds to be a technology leader. It takes imagination to create green energy
for the generations to come. At Siemens Gamesa we make real what matters.

[ Join the team at Siemens Gamesa ][33]

**Sustainability**

#### Delivering sustainability through actions

This decade will be judged on our ability to take the steps needed to keep global temperature rises
this century to between 1.5 and 2.0 degrees Celsius, as well as deliver a fairer and more equal
world. That is why as part of our Sustainability Vision 2040, we are focused not just on the targets
we set, but instead on the actions that are needed to deliver on them.

[ More information ][34]
[Siemens Gamesa SG 15-236 offshore wind turbine installation]

### The next milestone on Siemens Gamesa's industrialization journey: SG 15-236

Offshore wind is entering a new era—one defined by scale, standardization, and technology-proven
reliability. With the introduction of the SG 15-236, Siemens Gamesa marks the next major step in the
industrialization of offshore wind energy.

 
* [ Read more ][35]

### Sustainability: From nice-to-have to prerequisite for winning

In popular culture, wind turbines often serve as a type of visual shorthand for the dream of a
sustainable future. But in the real world, sustainability considerations have evolved into strategic
drivers and enablers for our company and customers in Siemens Gamesa.
* [ Read more ][36]

affordable energy systems for the future.]

# Wind technology powering tomorrow's energy systems

Siemens Gamesa is a global leader in wind energy, supporting companies and countries worldwide in
building resilient, affordable, and sustainable energy systems that accelerate the energy
transition.

[ [icon] Explore products and services ][28]
[Omterra logo following the announcement of the rebrand from Siemens Gamesa and Siemens Energy.]
Siemens Gamesa and Siemens Energy will become Omterra
Same team, same commitment – a new brand. Driven by our purpose to energize society, our strategy,
and our values.
[ Read our official announcement ][29]
1. Onshore
2. Offshore
3. Service

Your trusted technology partner

#### Onshore

Operating in 81 countries, Siemens Gamesa offers an extensive range of onshore wind turbine
technologies to cover all wind classes and site conditions. By listening to our customers - and
backed up by over 40 years of experience - we know just what it takes to develop and manage a
successful onshore project.

[
[icon]
Read more ][30]

Powerful performance

#### Offshore

Leading the way forward, our engineers and technicians pioneered the offshore sector back in 1991,
with the world’s first wind power plant in Denmark. Since then, Siemens Gamesa has grown to become
the global leader in offshore power generation. Offering full-scope solutions and services, our
people and products will guarantee the success of your next offshore project.

[
[icon]
Read more ][31]

World-class maintenance

#### Service

Siemens Gamesa has a proven track record of excellence in operation and maintenance. Leveraging
scale and global reach, we offer a flexible service portfolio that can be tailored to our customers’
diverse operating models. We also provide advanced diagnostics and digitalization capabilities, as
well as customized offshore offerings.

[
[icon]
Read more ][32]

**Career**

#### Passionate about renewables

It takes the brightest minds to be a technology leader. It takes imagination to create green energy
for the generations to come. At Siemens Gamesa we make real what matters.

[ Join the team at Siemens Gamesa ][33]

**Sustainability**

#### Delivering sustainability through actions

This decade will be judged on our ability to take the steps needed to keep global temperature rises
this century to between 1.5 and 2.0 degrees Celsius, as well as deliver a fairer and more equal
world. That is why as part of our Sustainability Vision 2040, we are focused not just on the targets
we set, but instead on the actions that are needed to deliver on them.

[ More information ][34]
[Siemens Gamesa SG 15-236 offshore wind turbine installation]

### The next milestone on Siemens Gamesa's industrialization journey: SG 15-236

Offshore wind is entering a new era—one defined by scale, standardization, and technology-proven
reliability. With the introduction of the SG 15-236, Siemens Gamesa marks the next major step in the
industrialization of offshore wind energy.

 
* [ Read more ][35]

### Sustainability: From nice-to-have to prerequisite for winning

In popular culture, wind turbines often serve as a type of visual shorthand for the dream of a
sustainable future. But in the real world, sustainability considerations have evolved into strategic
drivers and enablers for our company and customers in Siemens Gamesa.

Manufacturer & Exporter Around Globe

# ATICO - Laboratory Equipment Manufacturer & Exporter in India

Atico Scientific is an **ISO 9001–certified laboratory equipment manufacturer in India** and one of
the most trusted suppliers serving global institutions. We have been manufacturing and exporting
scientific, educational, and engineering equipment for many years.

Today, we are recognised among leading lab equipment manufacturers, laboratory glassware producers,
and research laboratory equipment exporters worldwide.

We serve schools, colleges, universities, hospitals, research laboratories, industrial labs, and
TVET institutions across many countries.

**Our product range includes:**
* School and college laboratory equipment
* Scientific and engineering lab instruments
* Research and industrial laboratory systems
* Laboratory microscopes and optical instruments
* Laboratory glassware and consumables
* Testing and quality control equipment

**Why institutions trust Atico:**
* ISO 9001–certified manufacturing systems
* In-house R&D and quality control
* Compliance with ASTM, IS, BIS, and ISO standards
* Experienced technical team
* Consistent product durability and performance
* Reliable after-sales support

[Contact Us][73]
[Laboratory equipment manufacturer India]
[Hospital and medical equipments]

###### Hospital And Medical Equipments

### Solutions for Medical Training Laboratory and Hospital Equipment

ATICO was established in the year 1954 and has since been engaged in the export of medical
equipment, hospital equipment, orthopaedic implants & instruments, laboratory equipment, and
scientific & educational products worldwide. Government of India recognised export house. Your
support has made us a Government of India recognised export house. Our goods have reached all
continents. With 40+ employees who are involved in activities related to production, inspections and
dispatch we assure you world class healthcare products delivered to your doorstep. Each employee has
in-depth knowledge about the product and has years of experience to back that knowledge.

[View Medical Range →][74]
[Civil and mechanical engineering]

###### Engineering Solutions

### Civil and Mechanical Engineering Machinery and Trainers

Welcome to Atico Export – Your Trusted Partner in Civil Engineering Lab Equipments, Construction
Materials Testing and Environmental Instrumentation Companies located at SAHA, India. Our
organization deals in Manufacturing, Supplying and Trading extensive range of Civil Engineering Lab
Equipment, Material Testing Lab Equipment, Building Material Testing, Non-Destructive Testing,
Pavement Engineering, Survey & Geospatial, Industrial Material Testing, Bitumen & Asphalt Testing,
Cement & Concrete Testing Soil Testing Lab Equipment. Our products are manufactured by employing
quality raw material and advanced technologies. The relevant features of our products are premium
quality, fine finish, dimensional accuracy, easy to operate, rugged construction and many more. We
have been able to garner huge market for our products. Join us as we continue to innovate and set
new standards in the industry. Discover the difference with ATICO EXPORT – Where Quality Meets
Excellence.

[View Engineering Labs →][75]
[Educational scientific instruments]

###### Educational & Scientific Instruments

# HYDROELECTRIC TURBINE SYSTEMS

## Premium Quality Systems and Components

Canyon Hydro builds hydroelectric systems to meet the rigid utility specifications of public and
independent power producers. In business for more than 45 years, we have gained wide recognition for
our highly efficient designs, premium quality components, and superb customer support.

[Download more information about our Precision Manufacturing][10]

### Canyon Hydro Commissions
### 25 MW Pelton Turbine

Canyon Hydro has successfully commissioned a 25 MW Pelton Turbine for the Trio Creek Hydroelectric
Project in British Columbia.

The five nozzle, 25 MW Vertical Pelton turbine was designed, engineered, manufactured and installed
by Canyon Hydro. The site, along Harrison Lake, BC, has a net head of 565 meters and maximum flow
rate of 5.5 cubic meters per second. Canyon specified a five nozzle Pelton turbine with a pitch
diameter of 1340mm (52.75 inches).

[[8.3 MW Vertical Pelton, British Columbia]][13]

### New Equipment Packages:
### Efficiency and Durability

[Pelton, Francis, In-line Francis, and Crossflow turbines and integrated water to wire packages with
generators, controls, switchgear, valves and ancillary equipment.
Learn More][14]

[[2 x 17MW vertical Francis refurbish project, New Mexico]][15]

### Refurbishment:
### Existing System Repair & Replacement

[We can completely overhaul, redesign and refurbish services with our experienced millwrights and
on-site engineering.
Learn More ][16]

[[CNC machine for large scale projects]][17]

### Machine Services:
### For Your Custom Projects

[Full design and CNC machining for custom projects. Large CNC horizontal boring mills programmed
with Siemens NX. Canyon supports aerospace, marine and pipe industries.
Learn More][18]

## The James Leffel & Co.

Canyon Hydro acquired The James Leffel & Co. in 2019.

Since 1862, The James Leffel & Co. has specialized in the design and manufacture of hydraulic
turbines in a wide range of capacities and types. Leffel equipment can best be summarized as
efficient, durable and trouble-free in its construction.

Equipment from The James Leffel & Co. is now supported by Canyon Hydro.

#### About the COMSOL Product Suite

The COMSOL Multiphysics^{®} software brings a user interface and experience that is always the same,
regardless of engineering application and physics phenomena.

Add-on modules provide specialized functionality for electromagnetics, structural mechanics,
acoustics, fluid flow, heat transfer, and chemical engineering. Choose from a list of LiveLink™
products to interface directly with CAD and other third-party software. Deploy simulation
applications with COMSOL Compiler™ and COMSOL Server™.

[Explore Product Suite ][38]
COMSOL Multiphysics^{®}

Create physics-based models and simulation applications with this software platform. The Model
Builder enables you to combine multiple physics in any order for simulations of real-world
phenomena. The Application Builder gives you the tools to build your own simulation apps. The Model
Manager is a modeling and simulation management tool.

[View COMSOL Multiphysics^{®} ][39]

COMSOL Compiler™

Compile apps into standalone executable files that can be run by anyone, anywhere.

[View COMSOL Compiler™ ][40]

Manage and distribute your organization's apps and run them via web browser or thin client.

[View COMSOL Server™ ][41]

exercises in an interactive setting.

Get to Know COMSOL

At COMSOL, we develop mathematical modeling software that drives new breakthroughs in physics and
engineering — and we love what we do.

Our mission is to provide easy-to-use software solutions to engineering problems and to help our
users get the most out of our products. We envision sustaining and reinforcing our position as a
leading provider and developer of mathematical modeling software. We also aim to make our technology
the primary tool for engineers, researchers, and lecturers within the fields of education and
high-tech product development.

**Quick Facts**
* Founded in 1986
* 16 offices and a distributor network throughout the world
* 500+ employees globally

Get to Know COMSOL

At COMSOL, we develop mathematical modeling software that drives new breakthroughs in physics and
engineering — and we love what we do.

Our mission is to provide easy-to-use software solutions to engineering problems and to help our
users get the most out of our products. We envision sustaining and reinforcing our position as a
leading provider and developer of mathematical modeling software. We also aim to make our technology
the primary tool for engineers, researchers, and lecturers within the fields of education and
high-tech product development.

specifications for grid connected plants as well as off-the-grid isolated sites.**

**SMALL AND MICRO SCALE HYDROELECTRIC SYSTEMS**                                                     
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                                                                                                    
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**Dependable Turbines Ltd. (DTL) was incorporated in 1978 and is now one of the premier companies in
the design and manufacture of water turbines for micro and small scale hydroelectric power plants   
worldwide.   Our [hydroelectric generators][7] range in capacity from 1kW, e.g. home power, net     
metering or rural electrification, up to 10,000kW, e.g. independent power producers (IPPs). The     
turbine-generators harness water power to produce electricity in a form of renewable energy.   We   
can supply power house equipment all the way from sophisticated electronically regulated turbine    
generator units complete with switch gear and controls, down to basic turbines and related          
individual components with manual controls.  Our hydroelectric systems are built to meet            
specifications for grid connected plants as well as off-the-grid isolated sites.**                  
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**Throughout the 40+ years history, we have built some of the [best hydro power generators][8], and 
with installations all over the world, it is an excellent testimony to our efficiency, reliability  
and cost effectiveness of our products and services that much of our business comes from repeat     
calls from existing clients.  We have a reputation for getting the job done on schedule and on      
budget.**                                                                                           
                                                                                                    
**If you want to go green and would like pricing for hydropower equipment, please take a moment to  
fill out a [pricing request form][9] ([Spanish form here][10]) with your contact information and    
site specifics of your hydro projects.**

# Full-Stack EV Infrastructure. National Execution.

Energy5 delivers complete EV charging infrastructure solutions — from early-stage planning and
incentive strategy to engineering, construction, and long-term operation.

We don't just install chargers. We design infrastructure that performs in real-world conditions,
aligns with long-term ROI, and scales across portfolios.

[Start Project][6][Partner With Us][7]

What We Do

## EV Charging Infrastructure, Built End-to-End

Energy5 manages the full lifecycle of EV charging projects, eliminating fragmentation and reducing
risk.

### Coordinated Structure

From site evaluation to live operational chargers, every step is handled within one structure. This
reduces delays, simplifies communication, and ensures accountability.

### Incentive Strategy Built-In

EV charging is a financial model. We integrate utility rebates, state funding, and federal
incentives into design, capturing funding without compromising quality.

### National Execution

Execution is where most fail. Supported by Utilities One Power Delivery, we deliver at scale
nationally with experienced crews and utility coordination expertise.

Why Energy5

## Built for the Reality of EV Infrastructure

The EV charging market is shifting from early adoption to large-scale deployment. At this stage,
success is no longer defined by how many chargers are installed — it is defined by whether those
systems perform reliably, generate returns, and integrate effectively with the grid.

#### Actual Usage Patterns

Designing infrastructure based on real-world needs and avoiding overbuilt or underutilized systems.

#### Long-term Economics

Aligning incentives directly with long-term economic performance and ROI.

#### Full Accountability

Delivering projects with complete execution accountability from start to finish.

[EV Charging Installation]

One Principle:

Infrastructure must work beyond installation day.

## Two Pathways to Success

01

### For Businesses

Deploy EV charging infrastructure that aligns with your business objectives. We help property
owners, fleet operators, and real estate developers.
* Evaluate site feasibility and infrastructure requirements
* Reduce capital costs through structured incentive strategies
* Implement systems designed for long-term reliability and ROI

[Start Project][8]
02

### For Partners

Scale EV infrastructure without building internal execution capabilities. We provide turnkey
delivery, white-label construction, and incentive support.
* Charge point operators (CPOs)
* Developers and portfolio owners
* EV networks and infrastructure platforms

[Partner With Us][9]

and at national scale.

# Full-Stack EV Infrastructure. National Execution.

Energy5 delivers complete EV charging infrastructure solutions — from early-stage planning and
incentive strategy to engineering, construction, and long-term operation.

We don't just install chargers. We design infrastructure that performs in real-world conditions,
aligns with long-term ROI, and scales across portfolios.

[Start Project][6][Partner With Us][7]

What We Do

## EV Charging Infrastructure, Built End-to-End

Energy5 manages the full lifecycle of EV charging projects, eliminating fragmentation and reducing
risk.

### Coordinated Structure

From site evaluation to live operational chargers, every step is handled within one structure. This
reduces delays, simplifies communication, and ensures accountability.

### Incentive Strategy Built-In

EV charging is a financial model. We integrate utility rebates, state funding, and federal
incentives into design, capturing funding without compromising quality.

### National Execution

Execution is where most fail. Supported by Utilities One Power Delivery, we deliver at scale
nationally with experienced crews and utility coordination expertise.

Why Energy5

## Built for the Reality of EV Infrastructure

The EV charging market is shifting from early adoption to large-scale deployment. At this stage,
success is no longer defined by how many chargers are installed — it is defined by whether those
systems perform reliably, generate returns, and integrate effectively with the grid.

#### Actual Usage Patterns

Designing infrastructure based on real-world needs and avoiding overbuilt or underutilized systems.

#### Long-term Economics

Aligning incentives directly with long-term economic performance and ROI.

#### Full Accountability

Delivering projects with complete execution accountability from start to finish.

[EV Charging Installation]

One Principle:

Infrastructure must work beyond installation day.

## Two Pathways to Success

01

### For Businesses

Deploy EV charging infrastructure that aligns with your business objectives. We help property
owners, fleet operators, and real estate developers.
* Evaluate site feasibility and infrastructure requirements
* Reduce capital costs through structured incentive strategies
* Implement systems designed for long-term reliability and ROI

[Start Project][8]
02

### For Partners

Scale EV infrastructure without building internal execution capabilities. We provide turnkey
delivery, white-label construction, and incentive support.
* Charge point operators (CPOs)
* Developers and portfolio owners
* EV networks and infrastructure platforms

[Partner With Us][9]

Execution Powered By

[[Utilities One Group]][10]

This combination of strategy and execution ensures projects are delivered consistently, efficiently,
and at national scale.

“Let's build EV infrastructure that works.”

## Gear Units

## FLENDER ONE

Welcome to a new era of industrial drive technology: individual, efficient, smart. FLENDER ONE® is
the new platform for the best industrial gear units from the Flender line. Available as single-stage
and multi-stage solutions, these gear units are suitable for over 100 applications.

[Discover Now ][237]

## Couplings

## First-class connections

The world’s largest portfolio of industrial couplings offers elastic, highly elastic, torsionally
rigid, hydrodynamic, backlash-free solutions as well as rail couplings.

[Couplings][238]

## Winergy

## Committed to the future

For more than 40 years Winergy gearboxes and generators ensure that wind turbines all over the world
convert wind power into electrical energy: reliable, efficient and at low lifecycle costs. In this
way we contribute to further decreasing the costs of energy production from wind in the future.

[About Winergy][239]

of Machinery and a designated manufacturer of small and medium-sized hydroelectric generator sets.
With 66 years of experience in the field of hydraulic turbines, in the 1990s, the system was
reformed and started to design, manufacture and sell independently. And began to develop the
international market in 2013.

Forster turbines have different types, specifications and reliable quality, with reasonable
structure, reliable operation, high efficiency, standardized parts, and convenient maintenance. The
single turbine capacity can reach 20000KW. The main types are Kaplan Turbine,Tubular Turbine,
Francis Turbine, Turgo Turbine, Pelton Turbine. Forster also provides electrical ancillary equipment
for hydroelectric power plants, such as governors, automated microcomputer integrated control
systems, transformers, valves, automatic sewage cleaners and other equipment.

## ABOUT US

Founded in 1956, Chengdu Forster Technology Co., Ltd. was once a subsidiary of the Chinese Ministry
of Machinery and a designated manufacturer of small and medium-sized hydroelectric generator sets.
With 66 years of experience in the field of hydraulic turbines, in the 1990s, the system was
reformed and started to design, manufacture and sell independently. And began to develop the
international market in 2013.

Forster turbines have different types, specifications and reliable quality, with reasonable
structure, reliable operation, high efficiency, standardized parts, and convenient maintenance. The
single turbine capacity can reach 20000KW. The main types are Kaplan Turbine,Tubular Turbine,
Francis Turbine, Turgo Turbine, Pelton Turbine. Forster also provides electrical ancillary equipment
for hydroelectric power plants, such as governors, automated microcomputer integrated control
systems, transformers, valves, automatic sewage cleaners and other equipment.

RESEARCH

##### Research Powering Tomorrow's Grid

technologies for tomorrow's grid.

ELECTRIFICATION

## Digital Blueprints for a Net-Zero Future

From a backyard wind turbine to engineering breakthroughs, see how Aspen Ideas fellow Melanie Li
Sing How advances renewable energy.

###### [Meet Melanie][46]

SMARTER GRID

##### Powering a More Resilient Future

Advanced grid intelligence helps utilities strengthen resilience, integrate cleaner energy, and
respond faster to disruptions.

###### [Learn More][47]

## Our Mission

At GE Vernova, we are united by a single, urgent, and optimistic mission: electrify to thrive and
decarbonize. The world needs us to accelerate the transition to more reliable, affordable, and
sustainable energy. Together, we have the energy to change the world.

[Learn more about us][48]

#### Latest Announcements

###### [View more][49]

#### **Subscribe to The Current** and explore the latest news on electrification systems and
#### software, energy generation technologies, and sustainability.

Subscribe Now

##### Partner with us

With a relentless passion for innovation and a diverse portfolio of leading technologies, GE Vernova
is continuing to electrify the world while simultaneously decarbonizing it. We will help reduce the
carbon-intensity of the world’s power systems by reducing the CO2 per kWh produced.

[Contact Us][50]

###### Come bring the energy to change the world

We are approximately 85,000 strong across about 100 countries around the world. If you are ready to
make a difference and usher in the new era of energy, come join us.

[Careers with GE Vernova][51]

#### Stay informed with GE Vernova News

Sign up to our newsletter to have the latest updates sent straight to your inbox.

## Quick inquiry

# GUGLER – Austrian Hydropower Technology

GUGLER Water Turbines GmbH is a leading supplier of – state of the art – turbine technology,
supplying all types of **Francis, Kaplan and Pelton turbines up to 40 MW per unit** and related
electro-mechanical equipment for small and medium sized hydro power plants (water to wire).

GUGLER Water Turbines GmbH supplies also special hydropower turbines, such as micro turbines,
container turbines, siphon turbines, gates turbines, turbines for drinking water pipelines on a
global basis.

## GUGLER – worldwide

For more than 100 years, our family has been dedicated to the development and construction of water
turbines, small hydropower plants and the generation of electricity from hydropower.
With more than 1,000 successfully installed turbines, the third-generation GUGLER family is one of
the world’s leading suppliers of water turbines up to 40 MW.

## Quick inquiry

# GUGLER – Austrian Hydropower Technology

GUGLER Water Turbines GmbH is a leading supplier of – state of the art – turbine technology,
supplying all types of **Francis, Kaplan and Pelton turbines up to 40 MW per unit** and related
electro-mechanical equipment for small and medium sized hydro power plants (water to wire).

GUGLER Water Turbines GmbH supplies also special hydropower turbines, such as micro turbines,
container turbines, siphon turbines, gates turbines, turbines for drinking water pipelines on a
global basis.

## GUGLER – worldwide

For more than 100 years, our family has been dedicated to the development and construction of water
turbines, small hydropower plants and the generation of electricity from hydropower.
With more than 1,000 successfully installed turbines, the third-generation GUGLER family is one of
the world’s leading suppliers of water turbines up to 40 MW.

# **World Hydropower Outlook**

The 2026 World Hydropower Outlook is the hydropower sector's flagship report, providing in-depth
analysis of hydropower’s evolving role in the energy transition.

[Read more][94]

## Discover Hydropower

Hydropower currently provides over 14% of the world's electricity. But more is needed if we are to
reach climate targets. Our annual World Hydropower Outlook sets out a roadmap to enable hydropower
and other renewables to deliver against urgent net zero targets
[Read more][95]
IHA Membership

## Strength in numbers

Encompassing over 100 organisations operating in more than 120 countries, IHA's members include the
world's leading hydropower developers, operators and manufacturers committed to the delivery of
sustainable hydropower under the guidelines of the San Jose Declaration. Join us to drive
sustainable hydropower and meet net zero targets.

# **World Hydropower Outlook**

The 2026 World Hydropower Outlook is the hydropower sector's flagship report, providing in-depth
analysis of hydropower’s evolving role in the energy transition.

[Read more][94]

## Discover Hydropower

Hydropower currently provides over 14% of the world's electricity. But more is needed if we are to
reach climate targets. Our annual World Hydropower Outlook sets out a roadmap to enable hydropower
and other renewables to deliver against urgent net zero targets
[Read more][95]
IHA Membership

## Strength in numbers

Encompassing over 100 organisations operating in more than 120 countries, IHA's members include the
world's leading hydropower developers, operators and manufacturers committed to the delivery of
sustainable hydropower under the guidelines of the San Jose Declaration. Join us to drive
sustainable hydropower and meet net zero targets.

## Find Frankie

Frankie is the reliable and dependable mascot for sustainable hydropower. In this activity, learn
about the many things we can do #WithHydropower. Frankie is hiding somewhere in these different
hydropower facilities. If you can find him, you’ll be rewarded with interesting facts and figures
about sustainable hydropower across the globe.

To date our community has made over 100 million downloads. It’s based on principles of collaboration, unobstructed discovery, and, most importantly, scientific progression. As PhD students, we found it difficult to access the research we needed, so we decided to create a new Open Access publisher that levels the playing field for scientists across the world. How? By making research easy to access, and puts the academic needs of the researchers before the business interests of publishers. [Authors, Editors and Institutions][10] We are a community of more than 103,000 authors and editors from 3,291 institutions spanning 160 countries, including Nobel Prize winners and some of the world’s most-cited researchers. Publishing on IntechOpen allows authors to earn citations and find new collaborators, meaning more people see your work not only from your own field of study, but from other related fields too. # Your Premier Micro Hydro Turbine Generator Manufacturer

Suneco Hydro is a leading CE certified manufacturer and supplier of reliable hydro power systems and
micro hydro generator.  Each micro hydro generator system includes a turbine, a generator and the
appropriate controller for the size and output of the system.  We offer competitive pricing and
excellent customer service.  Our systems come with a 3-year warranty. Suneco Hydro Power Systems are
available:  Pico systems are rated from 300 watts to 3 kw, Micro systems are rated from 5 kw to 10
kw.

Suneco Hydro Customer service includes assistance in matching the right size generator to your
specific site and requirements.  To use this service, please provide your site’s flow rate and head
as well as your wattage requirements.  Details and specifications of each system are available at
the Products tab.

# Water turbines designed for power generation in water networks

High efficiency water turbines generators based on PATs (pumps used as turbines) for renewable
energy generation in drinking water networks or in irrigation facilities.
Installation in water treatment plants, tanks, pressure reducing valves (PRVs), irrigation hydrants
or power generation from ecological flow in dams.
Significant energy savings through self-consumption of the energy produced by our electric water
generators or from surplus energy exported to the electric grid for selling.

## Applications of our PATs (pump as turbine)

[Preloader Image]
[power generation cological flow in rivers]
[electric generation rural hotels]
[installation water reservoirs]
[installation in irrigation pressurized networks]
[installation parallel with pressure regulation valves]
[mining facility turbine]
[turbine edar]

## Benefits of hydropower based in PAT (pump used as turbine)

Powerturbines, as hydro turbine manufacturer, provides different electric turbines models to work
with a wide range of flows and pressure drops, both to charge batteries or to export energy to the
electrical grid.

[Sale of energy to the grid]Export and selling energy to the electric grid

[Energy supply]Electric generation in remote areas

[Compatible with water]Compatible with drinking water, irrigation water or raw water

[Reduction of energy costs]Significant energy purchase savings

## Why choose Powerturbines as your water turbine manufacturer?

**Technical assistance** by our specialized team throughout the project. We will advise you on how
to execute the hydraulic and electrical installation.
**Short payback** thanks to a low investment cost. With our water turbine generator kit, you will
achieve significant savings on your electricity bill.
**Easy installation and maintenance**, similar to a conventional pump, which will allow you to carry
out these tasks with your own staff without having to depend on us.
**High efficiency** electric water turbines even with low flow rates. With our technology, it is
possible to generate energy where traditional turbines (francis, pelton or Kaplan) are not
applicable.
**100% renewable energy** source with minimal environmental impact. In addition, our water turbine
electric generators can operate in underground chambers totally hidden avoiding possible vandalism.
Water turbines derived from standard pumps made of **high quality and durable materials** like cast
iron or stainless steel.

# Water turbines designed for power generation in water networks

High efficiency water turbines generators based on PATs (pumps used as turbines) for renewable
energy generation in drinking water networks or in irrigation facilities.
Installation in water treatment plants, tanks, pressure reducing valves (PRVs), irrigation hydrants
or power generation from ecological flow in dams.
Significant energy savings through self-consumption of the energy produced by our electric water
generators or from surplus energy exported to the electric grid for selling.

## Applications of our PATs (pump as turbine)

[power generation cological flow in rivers]
[electric generation rural hotels]
[installation water reservoirs]

[turbine edar]

## Benefits of hydropower based in PAT (pump used as turbine)

Powerturbines, as hydro turbine manufacturer, provides different electric turbines models to work
with a wide range of flows and pressure drops, both to charge batteries or to export energy to the
electrical grid.

[Sale of energy to the grid]Export and selling energy to the electric grid

[Energy supply]Electric generation in remote areas

[Compatible with water]Compatible with drinking water, irrigation water or raw water

[Reduction of energy costs]Significant energy purchase savings

## Why choose Powerturbines as your water turbine manufacturer?

**Technical assistance** by our specialized team throughout the project. We will advise you on how
to execute the hydraulic and electrical installation.
**Short payback** thanks to a low investment cost. With our water turbine generator kit, you will
achieve significant savings on your electricity bill.
**Easy installation and maintenance**, similar to a conventional pump, which will allow you to carry
out these tasks with your own staff without having to depend on us.
**High efficiency** electric water turbines even with low flow rates. With our technology, it is
possible to generate energy where traditional turbines (francis, pelton or Kaplan) are not
applicable.
**100% renewable energy** source with minimal environmental impact. In addition, our water turbine
electric generators can operate in underground chambers totally hidden avoiding possible vandalism.
Water turbines derived from standard pumps made of **high quality and durable materials** like cast
iron or stainless steel.

and solar solutions, all of which you can browse directly on our website. We are immensely proud of
our strong industry partnerships and representing Sigenergy! One of our directors, Scott, recently
caught up with our friends at Failte Solar (one of Sigenergy's premier platinum partners), while
Charlie and Nik from our Sales team were proud to wear our new Sig hats out at Moor Park. These
relationships ensure we bring our installers reliable stock, competitive pricing, and top-tier
support. 🧢⛳ Head over to our website to check out the range, or reach out to our team to get a
quote for your next project! 📩 Plus, scan the QR code to download the mySigen app - the ultimate
tool for streamlined system setup for installers, and real-time AI energy monitoring for your
customers! 📱✨ 📞 Heathrow: 01753 983978 📞 Brackley: 01604 340018 ✉️ admin@rapidrenewables.co.uk
@sigenergy_official @sigenergy.global #SolarPV #EnergyStorage #Sigenergy #RapidRenewables

[ Investing in skills, training, and partnerships fo [Investing in skills, training, and
partnerships for a sustainable future 🚀 It’s been a busy, rewarding period at Rapid Renewables as
we expand our industry knowledge and strengthen our partnerships! Here’s a quick wrap-up of what
we’ve been up to: 🛠️ K2 Systems Training: Our buyer, Nimpreet, and Marketing Manager, Nicki, dove
into K2’s mounting solutions, roof types, and their DocuApp. This firsthand product insight directly
improves our buying strategies and online product support. 🎓 EEA Skills and Training Conference:
Nimpreet and Nicki also headed to the Institute of Directors in London to discuss addressing green
sector skills shortages alongside industry leaders like MCS and GSAP. 📐 Van der Valk Training:
Chris Campbell from Van der Valk Solar Systems walked our team through their latest mounting
solutions, intuitive new design system, and upcoming product rollouts. ⛳ Rapid Golf Day: All of
this training comes right on the back of our fantastic day out at Moor Park Golf Club! It was
brilliant catching up with so many of our amazing partners, customers, and co-sponsors on the green.
Investing in our team ensures we remain your trusted partner in the renewable energy sector! 🌍
#Renewables #GreenSkills #SolarEnergy #Networking #Events] ][156]

☀️🏌️‍♂️ It was an absolute treat to tee off in such a stunning setting. A massive thank you to everyone
at Moor Park for their outstanding hospitality and making sure everything ran so smoothly! 🏰✨
Thank you to all of our incredible partners, customers, and friends who joined us. To our
co-sponsors: Van Der Valk, DMEGC, and Failte Solar/Sigenergy: thank you for championing this event
alongside us. Your partnership is invaluable, and we're proud to work with such fantastic teams!
Despite the heat, everyone brought amazing energy and great competitive spirit. A massive shoutout
to Mark Holman and the team at Rapid Electrical Distributors for organizing such a fantastic day. We
were absolutely delighted to partner up with you! 🙌 We were also proud to support Rennie Grove
Peace Hospice Care and thank Jackie Jackson for sharing such an inspiring look into the vital work
they do. It was an incredible day of company, networking, and fundraising. We hope you all had a
brilliant time, and we can't wait to see you back out there in 2027! 🥂⛳ #GolfDay2026 #CharityGolf

**durable Photovoltaic Power Plants**. **Just benefit from our EXPERIENCE!**

who would like to make use of large roof areas to generate energy and revenue from sunlight? Then,
we have all the required solutions for you.

**SMART cs** delivers all type of photovoltaic products to suit all your requirements. We ensure the
highest standards of engineering and service for our pervasive network of partnerships with all
major manufacturers.

Benefit from solid and powerful results, well performing PV Plants and reliable Energy Solutions.


### Photovoltaic

We offer solutions for roofs and for industrial pv plants, according to your needs we do all the
planning of a perfectly working pv plant that produces in a reliable  quantity the forecasted energy
quantity.

[ all about PV ][10]

### LED

Do you want to save energy costs? If so, we offer energy saving LED technology for in-

& outdoor use:

 

   + offices

   + design luminaries

   + emergency lamps

   + high-bays and spot lights

   + luminous advertising

   + panels

   + pendant luminaries

   + tubes

   + stripes

   + shopping lights
   + street and parking lights

Finally, we also offer special LED lights; e.g. with ammonia resistance (stock-breeding or
agriculture).


 

[ all about LED ][11]

### Services

From buying project rights, to finding the best energy contract and finally to the shipping of your
purchases SMART cs offers all the necessary to satisfy your individual needs.

In addition to energy savings by integrating LED in your facilities we also offer two main services
which easily fit together: Either we reduce your energy costs through presenting you money saving
energy contracts with our large portfolio of German utilities or we help you to reduce your costs by
planning and realizing an accurate photovoltaic plant based on your current and future needs as well
as by implementing the necessary LED light in all your offices and warehouses.

### به وب سایت شرکت توربین ماشین خاورمیانه خوش آمدید!

این شرکت در سال ۱۳۸۰ با هدف تولید مجموعه های دوار، بروزرسانی و بهسازی سیستم های ماشین دوار و تولید
تجهیزات و پکیج های مرتبط در صنایع نفت ،گاز ،پتروشیمی ،نیروگاها و سایر صنایع مرتبط صنعتی تشکیل گردید
و با تدوین برنامه پنج ساله از تولید قطعات یدکی به تولید تجهیزات و پکیج های توربوپمپ ،توربو کمپرسور
،توربو ژنراتور و نیز سایر موارد در سال های اخیر رسیده است. در حال حاظر تولید انواع روتورهای دوار
،تولید و ساخت توربین های گاز ،بخار و انواع کمپرسورها و نیز ارائه خدمات ،تعمیرات اساسی ،پشتیبانی های
فنی و مهندسی و بروزرسانی و ارتقائ تجهیزات دوار موجود در سطح ملی با توسعه بازرهای خود نسبت به صدور
خدمات فنی و مهندسی برای حضور در بازارهای بین المللی نیز فعال می باشد.

### توربین ماشین خاورمیانه

هم اکنون این گروه صنعتی افتخار دارد که پروژهای بسایر متنوع و متعدد تخصصی را در صنعت نفت، گاز،
پتروشیمی، نیروگاهی، فولاد، در صنایع و غیره را با موفقیت به نتیجه و بهره برداری برساند.

#### هدف بنيادين مؤسسين شرکت توربین ماشین خاورمیانه

هدف عالی مؤسسین این گروه صنعتی رسیدن به خود کفایی در تولید تجهیزات دوار در مقیاسه صنعتی ،اشتغال زایی
،توسعه دانش فنی و مهندسی و جلو گیری از خروج متخصصین و افراد نخبه از کشور به منظور ایجاد سینرژی های
قوی در تشکیل تیم های جوان ،پویا در کنار افراد با تجربه صنعت بوده که سبب گردیده تا افزایش اثر بخشی
خدمات با افزایش کیفیت و ارتقاء سطح خدمات شرکت توامان گردد.

#### مبدا شکوفایی شرکت توربین ماشین خاورمیانه

مبدا شکوفایی حرکت مجموعه فنی و مهندسی ما این بود که استفاده از تجهیزات موجود کشور، سرمایه گذاری
درخصوص انجام آزمایشات، نمونه سازی و آموزش نیروی انسانی، و توسعه فعالیت و دامنه کاری را جایگزین هزینه
نمودن ارزی برای خرید ماشین آلات و تجهیزات جدید نمود و آن را سرلوحه کار خود قرار داد و همین موجب شد که
در طول دوران سخت اقتصادی، با ایجاد چرخه زنجیره ارزش ،همراه با آموزش های مدرن امروزی و بین المللی
درتمامی پروژه ها بدون هیچ محدودیت فنی و ابزار آلا

### توربین ماشین خاورمیانه

هم اکنون این گروه صنعتی افتخار دارد که پروژهای بسایر متنوع و متعدد تخصصی را در صنعت نفت، گاز،
پتروشیمی، نیروگاهی، فولاد، در صنایع و غیره را با موفقیت به نتیجه و بهره برداری برساند.

#### هدف بنيادين مؤسسين شرکت توربین ماشین خاورمیانه

هدف عالی مؤسسین این گروه صنعتی رسیدن به خود کفایی در تولید تجهیزات دوار در مقیاسه صنعتی ،اشتغال زایی
،توسعه دانش فنی و مهندسی و جلو گیری از خروج متخصصین و افراد نخبه از کشور به منظور ایجاد سینرژی های
قوی در تشکیل تیم های جوان ،پویا در کنار افراد با تجربه صنعت بوده که سبب گردیده تا افزایش اثر بخشی
خدمات با افزایش کیفیت و ارتقاء سطح خدمات شرکت توامان گردد.

#### مبدا شکوفایی شرکت توربین ماشین خاورمیانه

مبدا شکوفایی حرکت مجموعه فنی و مهندسی ما این بود که استفاده از تجهیزات موجود کشور، سرمایه گذاری
درخصوص انجام آزمایشات، نمونه سازی و آموزش نیروی انسانی، و توسعه فعالیت و دامنه کاری را جایگزین هزینه
نمودن ارزی برای خرید ماشین آلات و تجهیزات جدید نمود و آن را سرلوحه کار خود قرار داد و همین موجب شد که
در طول دوران سخت اقتصادی، با ایجاد چرخه زنجیره ارزش ،همراه با آموزش های مدرن امروزی و بین المللی
درتمامی پروژه ها بدون هیچ محدودیت فنی و ابزار آلات را با موفقیت به انجام برساند.

#### پشتیبانی

این گروه صنعتی با ایجاد تیم های مهندسی پویا و کارآمد که در حال حاظر جزو برترین تیم های تخصصی در حوزه
ماشینهای دوار در سطح کشور میباشد توانسته است پشتیبان واقعی برای رفع نیازهای طراحی ،مهندسی ،تولید و
بهره برداری بوده و به صورت کلید در دست در جهت ارتقاء تجهیزات دوار ،طراحی ماشین آلات و فرآیند های جدید
و نیز تولید و پشتیبانی تجهیزات موجود در صنعت کشور اقدام ویژه نماید
